name: oxbyte-qa
description: QA harness for oxbyte.blog — Lighthouse CI, Playwright + axe-core, Pa11y-CI, visual regression, security headers.

scripts.headers: security-headers https://oxbyte.blog --format table --output reports/security-headers.txt && security-headers https://oxbyte.blog --format json --output reports/security-headers.json
scripts.qa:all: npm run lhci && npm run test && npm run pa11y && npm run headers
